question_text: A flat relation has StudentID, StudentName, MajorID, MajorName, CourseID, CourseName. A student has one major and many courses; a course has many students. StudentID determines StudentName and MajorID; MajorID determines MajorName; CourseID determines CourseName. Construct a 3NF schema with primary keys and foreign keys.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: STUDENT(StudentID PK, StudentName, MajorID FK); MAJOR(MajorID PK, MajorName); COURSE(CourseID PK, CourseName); ENROLMENT(StudentID PK/FK, CourseID PK/FK). ENROLMENT has a composite key.

marking_points.criterion: Correct ENROLMENT with both foreign keys.
Correct composite enrolment key; no transitive major-name dependency.
